This is a form for students learning Motif Analysis for a project:

# Download Tools Control

```{r}
BiocManager::install(version = "3.19", ask = FALSE, force = TRUE)
BiocManager::install("Biostrings")
BiocManager::install("JASPAR2020", force=TRUE)
install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_version("TFMPvalue")
BiocManager::install("TFBSTools", force=TRUE)
BiocManager::install(c("Biostrings", "GenomicRanges", "muscle", "IRanges", "rtracklayer", "trackViewer"))
devtools::install_git("https://gitee.com/zhangrenl/lolliplot")    # need devtools package and git software
devtools::install_git("https://gitee.com/zhangrenl/genehapr")
```

# Prepare environment
```{r}
library(Biostrings)
library(JASPAR2020)
library(TFBSTools)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(ape)
library(pegas)
library(geneHapR)
```

# Make Position Weights Matrix

```{r}
pfm <- getMatrixByID(JASPAR2020, "MA0137.2")
pwm <- toPWM(pfm)
pwm <- as.matrix(pwm)
```

This can be used as a scoring system match motifs to a reference file:

# Finding Positions

```{r}
reverse = FALSE 
phylo = TRUE
gapless = FALSE
if(phylo == TRUE){
  seqs <- readDNAStringSet("Full_cmv_259sequences_Aln.fasta")
}else{
  seqs <- readDNAStringSet("hcmv15-hcmv1b-1.fasta")
}
if(gapless==TRUE){
  gapless_seqs <- DNAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(seqs))) 
}else{
  gapless_seqs <- seqs
}
if(reverse == TRUE){
  gapless_seqs = reverseComplement(gapless_seqs)
}
matched_peaks <- lapply(gapless_seqs, function(x) suppressWarnings(matchPWM(pwm, x, "45%"))) #This is similar to a for loop, when you want to just repeats a single function over and over
matched_motifs <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(matched_peaks), function(i) {
  starts <- start(matched_peaks[[i]])
  if (length(starts) == 0) return(NULL)
  seqname <- names(gapless_seqs)[i]
  motif_length <- ncol(pwm)
  motifs <- sapply(starts, function(pos) as.character(subseq(gapless_seqs[[i]], pos, pos + motif_length - 1)))
  scores <- sapply(seq_along(starts), function(j) {
  PWMscoreStartingAt(pwm, gapless_seqs[[i]], starts[j])
    })
data.frame(
    Sequence = seqname,
    Start = starts,
    Motif = motifs,
    Score = scores,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))
#count_peaks <- lapply(gapless_seqs, function(x) suppressWarnings(countPWM(pwm, x, "45%")))
matched_motifs <- matched_motifs %>% filter(!grepl('-', Motif))
if(phylo==TRUE){
  matched_motifs <- matched_motifs %>% group_by(Start) %>% filter(n() > 3)
  starts <- matched_motifs %>% distinct(Start) 
  for(i in 1:length(starts[[1]])){
    if(i==1){
      motif_seqs <- subseq(gapless_seqs, start = starts[[1]][i], end = starts[[1]][i] + 14)
    }
    else{
      subset <- subseq(gapless_seqs, start = starts[[1]][i], end = starts[[1]][i] + 14)
      motif_seqs <- DNAStringSet(paste0(as.character(motif_seqs), as.character(subset)))
    }
    names(motif_seqs) <- names(gapless_seqs)
  }
}
```

# Phylogeny of STAT1 Sites
```{r}
dist_matrix <- stringDist(motif_seqs[1:5], method = "hamming")
nj_tree <- nj(dist_matrix)
plot(nj_tree, main="Neighbor-Joining Tree")
```

# Tajima
```{r}
dnabin_obj <- as.DNAbin(motif_seqs)
tajima.test(dnabin_obj)
```

# Bootstrap the Tajima
```{r}
bootstrap_tajimas = c()
for(i in 1:1){
  x = width(gapless_seqs[1])
  len = length(starts[[1]])
  for(i in 1:len){
    if(i==1){
      starts_bs = sample(1:x, len)
      bootstrap_seqs <- subseq(gapless_seqs, start = starts_bs[i], end =  starts_bs[i] + 14)
    }
    else{
      subset <- subseq(gapless_seqs, start = starts_bs[i], end = starts_bs[i] + 14)
      bootstrap_seqs <- DNAStringSet(paste0(as.character(bootstrap_seqs), as.character(subset)))
    }
    names(bootstrap_seqs) <- names(gapless_seqs)
  }
  dnabin_obj <- as.DNAbin(bootstrap_seqs)
  taj = tajima.test(dnabin_obj)
  bootstrap_tajimas = c(bootstrap_tajimas, taj$D)
}
```

# Identity Gene Regions

```{r}
seqs <- readDNAStringSet("Full_cmv_259sequences_Aln.fasta")
hits_138 <- vmatchPattern('', reverseComplement(seqs), max.mismatch=15)
hits_136_start <- vmatchPattern('ATGTCAGTCAAGGGCGTGGAGATGCCAGAAATGACGTGGGACTTGGACGTTGGAAATAAATGGCGGCGTCGAAAGGTCCTGAGTCGCATTCACCGGTTCTGGGAATGTCGACTACGGGTGTGGTGGCTGAGTGACGCCGGCGTAAGA', reverseComplement(seqs), max.mismatch=20)
hits_136_end <- vmatchPattern('TCATCGCCCGAAACCGGCGACGATAGCAACGACGACGCGGTTGCCGGCGGAGGTGCTGGCGGGGTAACATCATCCGCGACTCGTACGACGTCGTCGAACGCGCTGCTGCCAGAATGGATGGATGCGGTACATGTGGCGGTCCAAGCCGCCGTTCAAGCGACCGTGCAAGTAAGTGGCCCGCGGGAGAACGCCGTATCTCCCGCTACGTAA', reverseComplement(seqs), max.mismatch=20)
hits_135 <- vmatchPattern('', reverseComplement(seqs), max.mismatch=50)
hits_133_start <- vmatchPattern('ATGGGTTGCGACGTGCACGATCCTTCGTGGCAATGCCAATGGGGCGTTCCCACGATTATTGTGGCCTGGATAACATGCGCGGCTTTAGGAATTTGGT', reverseComplement(seqs), max.mismatch=10)
hits_133_end <- vmatchPattern('TGCCGTGCAGGCGGCCATGGCCGCGGCTCTACAACAACAGCAGCAGCATCAGACCGGAACGTAA', reverseComplement(seqs), max.mismatch=15)
```

#Make Subsets for Four Genes

```{r}
subseq = subseq(reverseComplement(seqs), start=56729, end=57504)
gapless_subseq <- DNAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(subseq))) 
gapless_subseq <- gapless_subseq[width(gapless_subseq) == 768]
aa <- translate(gapless_subseq)
gapless_subseq <- gapless_subseq[!grepl("\\*", as.character(aa))]
writeXStringSet(gapless_subseq, 'UL133.fasta')

subseq = subseq(reverseComplement(seqs), start=57691, end=58614)
subseq_no_gaps <- subseq[!grepl("-", as.character(subseq))]
aa <- translate(subseq_no_gaps)
subseq_no_stop <- subseq_no_gaps[!grepl("\\*", as.character(aa))]
writeXStringSet(subseq_no_stop, 'UL135.fasta')

subseq = subseq(reverseComplement(seqs), start=58712, end=59446)
subseq_no_uk <- subseq[names(subseq) != "Europe_United Kingdom_GQ221974.1_Human_herpesvirus_5_strain_3157_complete_genome"]
gapless_subseq <- DNAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(subseq_no_uk))) 
gapless_subseq <- gapless_subseq[width(gapless_subseq) == 720]
aa <- translate(gapless_subseq)
gapless_subseq <- gapless_subseq[!grepl("\\*", as.character(aa))]
writeXStringSet(gapless_subseq, 'UL136.fasta')

subseq = subseq(reverseComplement(seqs), start=59532, end=60038)
#gapless_subseq <- DNAStringSet(gsub("-", "", as.character(subseq))) 
writeXStringSet(subseq, 'UL138.fasta')
```
